posts.text: FYI: I spent a full 72 hours with Rep. Jake Auchincloss in Washington D.C. last year. We recorded a mini-doc about it. Pretty interesting experience. piped.video/watch?v=8NFHYAMF…

My hot take about the next few years is that decency is going to make a comeback. I don't actually think there are many Americans left who appreciate or enjoy this era we are living through; I think the indecency has been tapped. It'll just take a decent, charismatic leader.

People who definitively do not have Trump Derangement Syndrome are going to be accused of having TDS because the president is acting deranged and they’re will to say so. Very weird circular derangement effects.
My full piece, with a h/t to @DavidAFrench on a theory about the electoratte being culturally thermostatic, too, not just on policy readtangle.com/decency-is-ab…

The fact that I can't tell whether this is genuinely our president or a hack is such a jarring, disorienting snapshot of our time. At some point, there aren't enough policy wins to make up for the degradation of what's acceptable; the president seems to be going mad before us.
